blocks.content: First, you need to detect when the timer reaches zero and end the game.
You'll add a check inside your countdown function. When time hits zero, you'll call a new function that ends the game.

Understanding the flow: Right now, countdown just decreases time and updates the display. You'll add an if statement that checks if timeLeft reaches 0, and if it does, call a function to end the game.

items: Modify the countdown function to check if timeLeft is less than or equal to 0.
If true, call a function named endGame. This will detect when the timer runs out and trigger the game-ending sequence.
